purpose: predict the controller state after one switch migration (what-if)
supported_action: single switch ownership migration between two controllers

selection.rule: Best Direct / Best Hybrid by lowest validation S; deployed = lowest validation S among Analytical, Best Direct, Best Hybrid

limitations: requires a valid TwinState and 5 consecutive valid snapshots
does not authorize migration: no safe field, the Safety Gate decides (Week 13)
trained on COMMITTED migrations only; rollback and NO_OP are not regression targets
response_p95_ms is controller processing time and does not rise with overload on this testbed
U is a lower bound of the offered load when a controller saturates (14 saturated attempts kept in the data)
few overload examples (10 in total, 1 in test): coverage near U = 1 is weakly supported
